title: Discount Period of the First Commuted Installment — Income Annuities Actuarial Note
content:
For a commutation of the remaining certain installments of an Ashgrove Income Annuities period-certain contract, the first commuted installment is discounted for a period measured in days from the election to the contract's next payment date. The days in a payment period are taken as the days per month, **30.4375**, multiplied by the months per payment period (1 monthly, 3 quarterly, 6 semiannual, 12 annual). The cutoff is **10** calendar days.

1. When the next payment date falls **more than 10 days** after the election, the first commuted installment is discounted by the days from the election to the next payment date divided by the days in a payment period.
2. When it falls **within 10 days** of the election (from the election day itself up to 10 days after), the first commuted installment is discounted by those days plus one payment period, divided by the days in a payment period.
3. Where the next payment date falls before the election day, neither of these measures applies.

Each later commuted installment is discounted one further payment period. A discount for a number of periods, whole or fractional, divides the installment by one plus the per-period rate, raised to the power of that number.

### Worked periods (hypothetical monthly contract, 30.4375 days in a payment period)

| Days from election to next payment date | Periods for the first commuted installment | Periods for the second |
|---|---|---|
| 20 | 20 divided by 30.4375, that is 0.6571 | 1.6571 |
| 11 | 11 divided by 30.4375, that is 0.3614 | 1.3614 |
| 10 | 40.4375 divided by 30.4375, that is 1.3285 | 2.3285 |
| 6 | 36.4375 divided by 30.4375, that is 1.1971 | 2.1971 |
| 0 | 30.4375 divided by 30.4375, that is 1 | 2 |

On a quarterly contract the days in a payment period are 91.3125; 45 days to the next payment date give 45 divided by 91.3125, that is 0.4928 of a period.
